title: Non-enzymatic electrochemical glucose sensing using flexible rGO/AgNW@PANI composite films on nylon substrates
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15313-15322
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00166A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ummul Kainatt, Nusrat Jahan Usha, Ayesha Binth Humayun, Md Rakibul Hasan, Arup Kumer Roy, Sumit Majumder
A flexible rGO/AgNW@PANI film on porous nylon, fabricated via vacuum filtration-spray coating, enables non-enzymatic glucose sensing with enhanced glucose oxidation and efficient charge transport, offering promise for wearable applications.
